# Anuj Bansal — Full Stack Developer & Software Engineer

> High-Performance Web Applications, Next.js 15, MERN Architecture & DevOps Systems

## Profile Summary
Anuj Bansal is a Full Stack Next.js Developer, MERN Engineer, and Software Specialist based in Indore, India. He builds scalable web applications, custom Payload CMS backends, interactive user dashboards, and secure Linux/Nginx server infrastructure.

## Key Capabilities & Stack
- **Frontend & UX**: Next.js 15, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Performance Optimization (90+ Lighthouse).
- **Backend & APIs**: Node.js, Express.js, Payload CMS, RESTful & GraphQL APIs, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).
- **Database & Storage**: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Redis.
- **DevOps & Infrastructure**: Linux (Ubuntu/Debian), Nginx reverse proxy, PM2 fleet management, Docker, SSL security.

## Core Services
1. **Full Stack Web Applications & SaaS**: End-to-end web apps with authentication, dynamic databases, and RBAC.
2. **Custom Business Websites**: High-speed Next.js websites built for lead generation and search engine indexing.
3. **Headless Payload CMS Solutions**: Type-safe CMS integrations empowering non-technical team management.
4. **DevOps & Nginx Optimization**: Server administration, security hardening, and 99.9% uptime monitoring.
